subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should this PR expose a gateway-drain bypass through the public ChannelRunQueue plugin SDK type, or keep the restart-drain bypass private to core-owned restart plumbing?
rationale: The proposed bypass affects plugin API and the gateway-draining security boundary, and repository policy treats plugin API changes as compatibility-sensitive public contract work.

options.title: Keep Bypass Private
options.body: Remove enqueueInternal from public ChannelRunQueue and route restart-drain work through a core-owned private helper or registry instead.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Bypass
options.body: Keep the new API only with explicit SDK docs, compatibility tests, and security rationale for third-party plugin use during gateway drain.

options.title: Pause For Broader Recovery
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer the durable restart recovery direction tracked by the related followup-queue persistence work.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Private
recommendation.body: Remove enqueueInternal from public ChannelRunQueue and route restart-drain work through a core-owned private helper or registry instead.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership spans the queue, plugin SDK, command queue, and inbound debounce surfaces involved in this decision.
